svg.aria-label: Breadboard layout: an ESP32 DevKit straddles the centre channel, its headers in rows b and j, so row a is the only reachable hole of a pin column. A jumper runs from a board GND pin to the lower blue rail. GPIO25, GPIO26 and GPIO27 each reach a free column through a 220 ohm resistor; in that column the LED anode sits in row a and the cathode goes into the blue rail. Tinted blocks mark holes that are internally connected.
svg.text: 220 Ω bridges the GPIO column to a free column
jumper: a GND pin on the board to the blue rail
LED anode in that column, cathode in the blue rail
